correctness.rationale: On a disjoint union each noun term has the disjoint-union interpretation by structural induction, including relative complement. All four atomic sentence forms are preserved, with strict cardinal inequalities adding, and the argument is sentencewise even for an infinite theory. A nonempty additive set has a least element a; for each attained residue modulo a, all elements in that residue are obtained by adding nonnegative multiples of a to the least attained representative. With h the sum of the chosen generators, k=max(1,ceil(log₂ h)) variables give at least h definable disjoint cells. Empty unused cells and equal cell sizes within each generator block of size g_i yield exactly the positive sums of g_i times nonnegative cell sizes. The converse constructs a partition for every such sum. When h=1 the forced unused cell causes no obstruction, and an explicit contradiction realizes empty spectrum. The bound is constructive, not claimed optimal. VERIFICATION.md and semigroup_spectra_verify.py were inspected, not executed; the finite checking does not replace this proof.
